caption:
Passwords leak. Two-factor authentication keeps your account locked anyway. 🔐

1️⃣ Open security settings in your email first
2️⃣ Turn on two-step verification
3️⃣ Choose an authenticator app if offered, it is safer than SMS
4️⃣ Save your backup codes somewhere safe

Do email first, then banking and social. 📌 Save this.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.title: Two-factor authentication
scenes.body: A second check after your password, like a code.
scenes.say: It is called two-factor authentication. You need a second check, like a code.

scenes.title: Set it up in minutes
scenes.say: Open security settings. Find two-step verification. Pick an authenticator app. Save your backup codes.
A text message code is better than nothing. But an authenticator app is safer.

scenes.title: Email first
scenes.body: Your email can reset every other account.
scenes.say: Start with your email. It can reset all your other accounts. Then do banking and social media.
